description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Order
categorisation: The gazette content is an order issued by the President under the Public Security Ordinance, calling out the armed forces to maintain public order in specified districts. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action—specifically, the invocation of a statutory power to make a security-related order. It does not primarily concern government personnel changes (Types 1-3) nor fit any other specialized category like Land, Commercial, or Elections. Therefore, it is classified under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
